correctness.rationale: Kummer counts outgoing carries including the last place, and subtracting the initial run T of 2s gives the Catalan valuation. Marking each initial canceled carry by x and every other carry by z=xy gives the stated two-state resolvent and numerator, including the all-2 word and L=0. The explicit digit witnesses realize every proposed support cell, and with a carry at every place the first non-2 digit must be 1 and each later digit 1 or 2, giving the top counts. Independently, for r=1/3 and q=r^L, outgoing carries c_i have Cov(c_i,c_j)=r^(j-i)(1-r^(2i))/4 for i<=j; conditioning on T>=j forces the first j carries and gives E[A|T>=j]=(L+j)/2+(1-r^(L-j))/4. These sums give Cov(A,T)=5/8-(L/2+3/4)q+q^2/8 and subtracting from Var(A) gives the claimed exact covariance. The dominant eigenvalue has the asserted logarithmic expansion near 1, and T is bounded in mean, giving the stated diagonal Gaussian limit by Slutsky. Fresh replay: python3 -B /workspace/reviews/reproduce.py 5 passed the digit-sum census through L=9, coefficients, support, boundary, moments and 729 direct binomial checks; finite computations do not prove the limit or unlimited depth.
